title: Missing moeb tool: Read — overflow result file reader
description: The Claude Code Read tool was used during fix_signal to read kernel-generated overflow files produced when mcp tool results exceeded the token limit. No moeb-registered tool can read these externally-saved overflow files. This forces the agent off the moeb tool path whenever a tool result is too large.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a read_overflow_result tool that accepts an overflow file path and returns a paginated excerpt, or extend moeb tools to stream large results rather than saving to external files.
